Featured Software

SeisTool

Rock Physics Analysis Software

SeisTool provides a comprehensive environment for rock physics analysis, enabling geoscientists to understand and predict seismic response to changes in rock and fluid properties.

Built on established rock physics theory, SeisTool implements the same algorithms used in our consulting projects, giving you direct access to the tools that power TraceSeis analyses.

Core Capabilities

Fluid Substitution: Gassmann-based modeling for predicting seismic response to fluid changes
AVO Modeling: Synthetic gather generation using Zoeppritz equations and approximations
Crossplot Analysis: Interactive visualization of elastic property relationships
Log Analysis: Well log display, editing, and rock physics computation
Rock Physics Templates: Build and apply RPTs for lithology/fluid discrimination

Theoretical Foundation

SeisTool implements established rock physics models:

  • - Gassmann (1951): Low-frequency fluid substitution
  • - Batzle-Wang (1992): Fluid property estimation
  • - Zoeppritz (1919): Reflection coefficient computation
  • - Aki-Richards: Linearized AVO approximation
  • - Shuey (1985): Two/three-term AVO
